changes_made.explanation: Added 'Dialogue Generation' as the main task since the paper generates multi-turn conversational contexts. Normalized model name by removing version number. Simplified output descriptions while maintaining accuracy.
The paper only uses retrieval evaluation metrics (MRR, NDCG@3, Recall@10) to evaluate retrieval performance, not NLG evaluation metrics. No automatic NLG evaluation metrics are mentioned.
No LLMs are used as judges to evaluate generated outputs. LLMs are only used for data augmentation generation, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation of the generated conversational data is mentioned in the paper. Only automatic retrieval metrics are used for evaluation.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on conversational dense retrieval using LLM-generated data augmentation. While it generates conversational data (dialogue generation and paraphrasing), the evaluation is solely on retrieval performance using standard IR metrics (MRR, NDCG@3, Recall@10), not NLG quality evaluation. The LLM (Llama 2-Chat) is used only for data generation, not for evaluation.
